create_mppi_instance: create an MPPI trajectory optimization instance with environment, horizon, and parallel rollout config
run_mppi_train_step: run the MPPI train step to perform trajectory rollouts, score paths, and advance the environment
update_mppi_action_sequence: update the MPPI action sequence by blending sampled trajectories weighted by their scores
advance_mppi_time_step: advance the MPPI time step by executing the first action and shifting the action sequence
score_mppi_trajectories: score MPPI trajectories using the final reward from each sampled rollout path
